messages:
Maya (Design): New responsive pass uploaded. Focus: sidebar collapse, table overflow, and a subtle drag-to-dismiss on the filter sheet. Please smoke test on small devices and flag any accessibility issues. :mag_right:
Olu (Product): Quick ask: keep a compact two-line table option for 480-520px phones. Power users rely on density. Can we avoid switching to cards until <=420px?
Elaine (Frontend): Prototype currently flips to compact rows at 510px and to stacked cards at 400px. CSS: `@media (max-width:510px){.row--compact{height:56px}} @media (max-width:400px){.results-table{display:none}.cards{display:block}}`
Nora (A11y): If DOM changes from table -> list, make sure to update roles: `role=\"list\"` + `role=\"listitem\"`. Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` when filters open/close and label the close button `aria-label=\"Close filters\"`.
Maya (Design): Copy tweak: header should say "Filter results" and the pill that shows current sort should read "Sort: Most relevant" (visible to screen readers). Also add visual affordance for drag handle in the sheet.
Elaine (Frontend): Keyboard issues noted on iOS: input focus pushes the action bar under the keyboard. Plan: listen to `visualViewport` and apply `.keyboard-open` to increase bottom padding and translateY. Also will debounce resize so layout doesn't flip mid-scroll.
Olu (Product): Also add an analytics event when layout changes and when keyboard is open at submit time. Helps correlate support tickets.
QA Bot: Test checklist: 1) breakpoints at 510 and 400; 2) keyboard open behavior on iOS Safari; 3) drag-to-dismiss doesn't conflict with list scrolling; 4) preserve selected row after navigate/back; 5) color contrast for chips >=4.5:1.
Nora (A11y): For chips ensure they are focusable and use `role=\"button\"` with `aria-pressed` when active. Truncate long text with `aria-describedby` pointing to full meta.
Elaine (Frontend): Will push a small PR with debounce, keyboard handling, sticky sort pill, and chip a11y. Referencing ticket INF-941.
Maya (Design): I'll adjust figma: reduce avatar 28px at <=420, title font 13 at <=360, add drag handle spec and spacing for sticky pill. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/mobile-filter-updates
Olu (Product): Sounds good. I'll try staging on iPhone SE and iPhone 12. Drop screenshots here if anything odd.
Maya (Design): Thanks — closing thread after device checks. :white_check_mark:
